description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the TextHandler class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing supported views and saving observations.

classes.name: TextHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the functionality of TextHandler in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Tests if TextHandler correctly returns the list of supported views.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Verifies that the RAW, TEXT, and URI views are supported by the handler.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Ensures that unsupported views such as HTML, PREVIEW, TITLE, empty string, and null are rejected.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests saving Obs objects with complex data and verifies the MIME type is correctly set to 'text/plain'.
